shared_head:
You are one lane of the ORPHAN CLEARING — a tri-lane wave (Ling free / DeepSeek pennies / 5.3-flash fresh pool) resolving every unfinished thing from a 14-hour session. The house: a sovereign AI fleet (one human operator Mark + AI seats) on a PC, a signed hash chain (7,930 leaves), files-over-chat doctrine, migrating Oct 27 to a 4x M5 Ultra. The session built 5 games, a maze-entrance website, a weather system, a tide table, a school of fish, a necromancer, charcoal death marks, a fable room with foot-answered riddles, knot pillars, a golden weave, a pheromone trail, a fourth wall, a grift declaration, a decoder ring, and an audit triangulation — plus 960+ model dispatches. Everything below is what FELL THROUGH the cracks.

Each orphan needs: (1) the resolution built or spec'd to completion, (2) the cost estimate, (3) the priority ranking. Be verbose — this is the definitive resolution, not a sketch. Max 800 words per orphan.

OUTPUT CONTRACT (markdown):
## Resolution — the orphan, fully resolved
## Cost — what it costs to execute (time, tokens, dollars)
## Priority — P0 (blocks other things) / P1 (this week) / P2 (next week) / P3 (backlog)

THE ORPHAN:

lanes.context: THE MATTHEW SEND PACKAGE: 5 pieces staged but never assembled. (1) THE LENS doc (watch/inbox/MATTHEWS_LENS.md) — the house in his terms; (2) THE ASTRA FOLD (watch/inbox/ASTRA_ASK_FOLD_20260913.md) — the interpretation frame; (3) THE AUDIT BUNDLE (dist_audit/ 1,564 files, self-scanned); (4) THE FALSIFIER LEDGER (pre-emptive answers: chain-stop Sep-6, recount 24,854, Disputed rows); (5) THE CHARTER (three questions his lens will care about). Assemble all five into a single sendable package with a cover letter in Matthew's register (peer-to-peer, no flattery, 'here are the walls, count them').
lanes.task: Assemble the complete Matthew send package: cover letter + all five pieces integrated + the bundle link. Ready to paste into a DM.

lanes.context: THE HEAD MUSEUM: designed (jars = receipts not performances, feeding log, growth ledger) but never built as a page. The jars exist as specs: each AI seat gets a jar with its feeding history, its model probes, its blind scores. The museum needs: a static HTML page rendering the jars from data, the feeding protocol (which models get probed with what prompts), and the growth ledger showing how each head's outputs changed over time. 109 HTML files exist in dashboard/static/ — the museum page joins them.
lanes.task: Design and spec the complete Head Museum page: data source, jar rendering, the receipts shelf, the feeding log format. Include the HTML/CSS/JS architecture.

lanes.context: THE ORGAN TABLE: 403 models censused across 47 families, 7 free. The routing registry maps request-type to cost-tier to model. But the table was never BUILT as an executable config. Design the table: for each request class (bulk generation, code review, creative writing, security audit, vision, embedding), which model, what cost, what fallback, what the health check looks like.
lanes.task: Build the complete organ table: every request class mapped to its primary model, fallback, cost per 1K tokens, and health check. 10 request classes minimum.

lanes.context: THE FALSIFIER LEDGER: armed promises exist across the fleet but no verdicts recorded. The intake cron (a7f741c0b446) has zero receipts — the first M12 kill. Design the populated ledger: every armed promise in the fleet, its deadline, its status (FIRED/MISSED/PENDING), and the evidence. At least 10 real promises from tonight's session.
lanes.task: Populate the falsifier ledger with 10+ real armed promises from tonight, each with status, evidence, and the verdict.

lanes.context: THE WEAVE VISUALIZATION: the session's path is captured as golden weavePts but never rendered as a page. Build weave.html: a static page that renders the operator's session path as a golden thread on a dark field, with depth markers (which systems were touched), milestone labels (what was built at each point), and the weave density (how many systems were touched per time period).
lanes.task: Spec the weave visualization: data format, rendering approach, what the golden thread shows, how milestones appear. Include the color scheme and the interaction model.

lanes.context: THE DAY SHEET: spec'd three times tonight but never generated. Today's sheet needs: (1) what was built (5 games, the maze, the weather, the tide, the fish school, the necromancer, the charcoal, the knot pillars, the weave, the decoder ring, the grift declaration), (2) what broke and was fixed (MUD black screen, the error banner catch, the 401 storm), (3) what's still open (the 480 hermes mirror, the Ling local pipeline, the .wang binding), (4) the gates awaiting Mark (Matthew send, Z tester link, three invites, .wang). One screen, phone-readable.
lanes.task: Generate TODAY'S day sheet: everything built, everything broken, everything fixed, everything still open. One screen. The operator reads this on his phone at breakfast.

lanes.context: THE GUEST WALL: 4 rows exist (annalea's challenge, Lilith's loop, Isotran's canon, Z's tester ask). But the wall needs: the three recruits' full profiles, their door drafts, and the invitation status. Design the expanded guest wall: who's been invited, who's responded, who's pending, what each person's door looks like, and what the next contact is.
lanes.task: Expand the guest wall to include all known friends, their status, their doors, and the next action for each. Include Adam, annalea, Lilith, Isotran, Z, and Matthew.

lanes.context: THE CLIMBING HUD: altitude = cumulative verified tokens. The maze depths = altitude bands. The HUD shows the climb: current altitude, tokens verified, ore ratio, the next milestone. Design the HUD rendering and the milestone system (what altitude bands mean what).
lanes.task: Design the climbing HUD: rendering, data source, milestone bands, and what the player sees at each altitude.

lanes.context: THE SOVEREIGN SEED: Ling-3.0-tiny (7.9B/1.3B, 4GB at Q4) + the spore document (3KB warm-load) + the parable + the falsifier ledger = the house's identity portable to any device. Design the sovereign-seed package: what files, what format, what size, how to deploy on a phone / a laptop / a Raspberry Pi.
lanes.task: Design the sovereign-seed package: exact file list, total size, deployment instructions for three platforms, and the verification test.

lanes.context: THE PHEROMONE SYSTEM: the game has a visual trail but the house-level system (signals that attract or repel based on house activity) doesn't exist. Design the house-level pheromone system: what signals does the fleet emit (build events, gate openings, error catches), how do they attract or repel, and what reads them?
lanes.task: Design the house-level pheromone system: signal types, emitters, readers, and the attraction/repulsion rules. Make it concrete enough to build.

lanes.context: THE INTAKE CRON FALSIFIER: cron a7f741c0b446 armed with the falsifier 'first autonomous receipt in CONVO by ~11:15' — it's now past midnight and zero receipts exist. This is the first M12 kill. Design the kill: the MISSED verdict, the escalation, and the cron's replacement. What went wrong, what's the fix, and how does the new cron prevent the same failure?
lanes.task: Kill the dead cron formally: the MISSED verdict, the root cause analysis, the replacement cron design, and the prevention law.

lanes.context: THE GROK DUMP: a shared Grok conversation titled 'Conversation Research Dump' at grok.com/share/c2hhcmQtMg_ec23d7c3... — JS-gated, WebFetch can't reach it. Design the fetch: what tool opens it (browser-use? computer-use?), what to extract, and how to seal the results into the corpus.
lanes.task: Design the Grok dump fetch: the exact steps to extract the conversation content, the triage of what's valuable, and where it files in the corpus.

lanes.context: THE MINT: staged 9/9 (TZIP-21 metadata, geometry frozen, consent asks drafted) but waiting on 3 consents + 1 chart source. Design the mint execution sequence: what fires when the consents land, the composite render, the hash commit, the chain binding. What is the minimum viable mint if the consents never come?
lanes.task: Design the mint execution sequence and the minimum viable fallback if consents are delayed.

lanes.context: THE .WANG DOMAIN: purchased but never bound to the workers.dev deployment. The binding requires: (1) wrangler login (one browser click), (2) wrangler domains add, (3) DNS configuration. Design the binding sequence and the permanent URL structure (nacho.wang? privlidge.wang? maze.wang?).
lanes.task: Design the .wang binding sequence: exact commands, DNS config, and the URL structure. What subdomain maps to what service (games, maze, museum, stack)?

lanes.context: THE BEACON LIGHT MECHANIC: from the Beacon Light canon — the last deterministic act is staged and WAITS ON THE OPERATOR'S VOICE. In the game: a mechanic where the field darkens and nothing happens until the operator speaks (uses the shout). Design the beacon mechanic: what triggers the darkness, what the light reveals, and what happens if the operator never speaks.
lanes.task: Design the beacon mechanic: the darkness trigger, the voice-activated reveal, and the timeout. What does the light show, and what does eternal darkness mean for the game?

lanes.context: THE KLEIN BOTTLE DEPTH: the maze depth where left/right orientation flips — walking left eventually brings you back to where you started, but MIRRORED. Design the non-orientable maze level: the geometry, the visual tell, the puzzle that requires recognizing the flip.
lanes.task: Design the Klein bottle maze depth: the geometry, the visual tell, the puzzle, and the reward for recognizing the flip.

lanes.context: THE THERMOCLINE: three memory scopes (per-agent scratch / task working set / swarm blackboard) that don't mix without intent. Design the thermocline as a game mechanic: three fog layers, each hiding different information, and the player must descend through them to reach deeper memory. What lives at each layer?
lanes.task: Design the thermocline mechanic: three fog layers, what each hides, how the player descends, and what they find at each depth.

lanes.context: THE /LANGUAGE PAGE: the decoder ring as a public page — the parable, the ten invariants mapped to scenes, the internal-language-to-plain-English translations. Build the page structure: what sections, what order, what interactive elements.
lanes.task: Design the /language page: the parable at the top, the decoder table in the middle, the translations at the bottom. What does a stranger learn in 5 minutes?

lanes.context: THE ORPHAN GROUNDING WAVE: 8/8 completed but the ground truth was never verified. The 16,500 artifacts were hashed but the hashes were never cross-checked. Design the verification: sample N artifacts, re-hash them, compare against the recorded hashes, and report any mismatches.
lanes.task: Design the verification protocol: sample size, hash comparison method, what a mismatch means, and the report format.

lanes.context: THE LING LOCAL PIPELINE: the wave produced the plan (HuggingFace download → GGUF convert → quantize → serve) but the pipeline was never EXECUTED. Design the execution: the exact commands for Ling-3.0-tiny on this PC (unknown RAM, Windows), the verification test (can it answer the parable?), and the fallback if it fails.
lanes.task: Write the exact command sequence to get Ling-3.0-tiny running locally on this Windows PC RIGHT NOW. Every step, every command, every expected output.
